query:
INSERT INTO news (title, slug, excerpt, date, categoryId, coverImageUrl, blocks)
VALUES (
  'Native Gardens',
  'native-gardens-pioneer-theatre',
  'Brandon PT Davis served as Assistant Scenic Designer for Pioneer Theatre Company Utah premiere of Native Gardens, providing drafting and 3D modeling support for Jo Winiarski extraordinary scenic design featuring two full house exteriors and realistic yards.',
  '2024-01-27',
  (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE name = 'Assistant Scenic Design' LIMIT 1),
  'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663337866878/ZLIpRCAFaXVvAbCe.jpg',
  '[
    {"type":"text","content":"Brandon PT Davis served as Assistant Scenic Designer for Pioneer Theatre Company Utah premiere of Native Gardens by award-winning playwright Karen Zacarías. Working with scenic designer Jo Winiarski, Davis provided drafting and 3D modeling support for an extraordinary design featuring two full house exteriors with realistic yards that transformed the stage into a contemporary D.C. neighborhood."},
    {"type":"header","content":"The Production"},
    {"type":"text","content":"This contemporary comedy explores what happens when well-intentioned neighbors become feuding enemies in a garden party culture clash. The production examines notions of race, taste, class, and privilege through the story of a young couple and their well-established neighbors engaged in an all-out border dispute over a fence line."},
    {"type":"team","title":"Creative Team","members":[{"name":"Timothy Douglas","role":"Director"},{"name":"Jo Winiarski","role":"Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Brandon PT Davis","role":"Assistant Scenic Designer"},{"name":"Lex Liang","role":"Costume Designer"},{"name":"Peter Maradudin","role":"Lighting Designer"},{"name":"Matthew M. Nielson","role":"Sound Designer"},{"name":"Amoirie Perteet","role":"Projection Designer"}]},
    {"type":"link","url":"https://pioneertheatre.org/production/native-gardens/","text":"Visit Pioneer Theatre Company"}
  ]'
);
